title: Game reversing and reconstruction discovery
summary: Review eleven game reversing and reconstruction projects.
notes: Personally screened the current catalogue and primary pinned documentation. No independent build, execution, gameplay or binary comparison.

sources.reason: Function maps, working notes, Ghidra scripts and selected decompiler output across three builds; not a full reconstructed source tree.
Function maps cover stage, title and briefing programs; most names are explicitly provisional.
Function naming and review records cover the Saturn main program and Model 2 arcade version; no game binaries or reconstructed source are distributed.
Names and review records cover 38 Saturn overlays, with cross-overlay tooling; no game program or decompiled C included.
Function maps and review records cover multiple Clockwork Knight titles and compilation programs; provisional labels remain author interpretations.
Function maps and tooling study the Saturn FPS main program; README marks remaining names provisional.
Function maps and labels study the two 68000 programs of the System 21 arcade game.
Function-by-function x86-64 port of the Win16 game with NE analysis and call graph; original resources are not distributed.
Partial work-in-progress disassembly for scenario 1, with Lua viewers for maps, commands and graphics in Spectrum Analyser.
Chinese translation of the MSX2 game reorganizes original and expanded banks into Z80 assembly including logic, graphics and sound modules.

project.title: Faxanadu — Atari ST port
project.status: Source reviewed; no independent build or execution

identity.narrative: Faxanadu is identified in the pinned project README.

classification.narrative: Work-in-progress 68000 Atari ST port based on chipx86's NES disassembly, using assets extracted from a user-supplied ROM. The current plan reports progress beyond the stale colour-bars-only README: screen rendering, scrolling, input, walking and jumping; other systems are unfinished.

target_cpu.narrative: The README specifies a 68000 Atari ST build.

build.limitations: No independent build, execution, gameplay or byte comparison was performed.

ai.narrative: The README explicitly states the port was built with AI help, without identifying a tool.

relationships.narrative: Uses chipx86's NES disassembly; distinct from the tracked NES-to-PC recompilation.
